Family history of skin cancer can provide additional risk factors and help in differential diagnosis.
A detailed medical history can help in understanding the patient's overall health status and potential underlying conditions.
impact_on_differential: Without a biopsy report, it is difficult to definitively rule out malignancy, which is a critical consideration in differentiating between basal cell carcinoma and malignant melanoma.

A detailed medical history can reveal other health issues that might influence the interpretation of the lesion.
